subject: OneTrust evidence bundle + follow-up on CAIQ fields
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <trust-sig@atlaspartners.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood - OneTrust invite + initial evidence request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for agreeing to work with Atlas Partners on our vendor security review. I just sent an automated OneTrust invite to kimberly_park@redwood.com — you should see the portal link in your inbox (noreply@onetrust.com).

To accelerate the review, could you upload the following items into the OneTrust workspace and reply here once complete?
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Brief network architecture diagram showing segmentation and DMZs
- KMS policy or encryption overview (at-rest and in-transit)
- List of subprocesors and cloud regions

If any of those need to be redacted, let me know and we can provide an NDA/Additional Redaction Guidance form. We generally need the docs by EOD Friday 12/4 to keep to our procurement timeline.

Appreciate it — please loop in your security lead if helpful.

Best,
Alex
Alex Mercer
Vendor Risk Analyst, Atlas Partners
security-portal@atlaspartners.com

Attachment: None (OneTrust invite sent)
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Alex Mercer <trust-sig@atlaspartners.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - OneTrust invite + initial evidence request

Alex,

Thanks — I accepted the OneTrust invite and started the workspace. We uploaded a preliminary evidence bundle to the portal this morning: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, Network_Architecture_Diagram.png, and Encryption_KMS_Overview.pdf. I left a short note on the SOC 2 about the redaction (we redacted customer names and IPs).

A couple of quick notes / asks:
- Our KMS uses Azure Key Vault for most tenant data; we included the KMS overview PDF. If you need service principal or rotation logs, that will need a short follow-up (we can export tailored logs).
- For subprocessor listing, we included the high-level vendor roster in the OneTrust fields and attached a CSV with the primary cloud regions.

If the team needs the CAIQ/SSVC prompts filled, we can either populate the OneTrust questionnaire or drop a CSV with responses — which do you prefer?

Targeting your 12/4 timeline, but flagging that if you request raw rotation logs that may slip 24–48 hours while infra runs the export.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Ops (security liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in portal: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, Network_Architecture_Diagram.png, Encryption_KMS_Overview.pdf
From: Alex Mercer <trust-sig@atlaspartners.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood - OneTrust invite + initial evidence request

Kimberly —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. The docs in the portal look good as an initial pass. Two follow-ups from the security team:
1) Could you populate the CAIQ-derived questions in OneTrust rather than sending a CSV? It helps our reviewers tie answers to specific control artifacts. If time is tight, a partial CAIQ with critical controls is fine.
2) We need an exported excerpt of your CAIX/CAIQ responses for the following controls: CC7 (encryption key management) and CC6 (access provisioning). Your portal upload field accepted a small CSV; if easier you can upload Vendor_Response_CAIX_excerpt.csv.

Also, we saw a reference in the SOC 2 to a third-party incident response retainer — could you share the retainer name and contact or a redacted statement that confirms coverage?

If you can get those items in by Friday 12/4 EOD we should be able to keep the vendor review on schedule.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex —

Quick update: we completed the CAIQ fields in OneTrust and uploaded the CAIX excerpt as requested (Vendor_Response_CAIX_excerpt.csv). Also attached in the portal: the redacted retainer confirmation (third-party-retainer-redacted.txt).

Summary of uploads and where they live in OneTrust:
- Evidence tab: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, Network_Architecture_Diagram.png, Encryption_KMS_Overview.pdf
- Questionnaire: CAIQ (populated) — key controls CC6/CC7 filled with references
- Supplemental files: Vendor_Response_CAIX_excerpt.csv, third-party-retainer-redacted.txt

We did not include raw rotation logs in the portal; if you require them for in-depth review, please ping dev_patel@redwood.com and we can schedule an export (may take 24–48 hours).

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call with your reviewer if anything looks unclear. Proposed slots: Tue 12/7 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 12/8 13:00–13:30 PT.

Thanks,
Kimberly
